- update-config: Use this skill to configure the Claude Code harness via settings.json. Automated behaviors ("from now on when X", "each time X", "whenever X", "before/after X") require hooks configured in settings.json - the harness executes these, not Claude, so memory/preferences cannot fulfill them. Also use for: permissions ("allow X", "add permission", "move permission to"), env vars ("set X=Y"), hook troubleshooting, or any changes to settings.json/settings.local.json files. Examples: "allow npm commands", "add bq permission to global settings", "move permission to user settings", "set DEBUG=true", "when claude stops show X". For simple settings like theme/model, suggest the /config command.
- keybindings-help: Use when the user wants to customize keyboard shortcuts, rebind keys, add chord bindings, or modify ~/.claude/keybindings.json. Examples: "rebind ctrl+s", "add a chord shortcut", "change the submit key", "customize keybindings".
- simplify: Review changed code for reuse, quality, and efficiency, then fix any issues found.
- fewer-permission-prompts: Scan your transcripts for common read-only Bash and MCP tool calls, then add a prioritized allowlist to project .claude/settings.json to reduce permission prompts.
- loop: Run a prompt or slash command on a recurring interval (e.g. /loop 5m /foo). Omit the interval to let the model self-pace. - When the user wants to set up a recurring task, poll for status, or run something repeatedly on an interval (e.g. "check the deploy every 5 minutes", "keep running /babysit-prs"). Do NOT invoke for one-off tasks.
- schedule: Create, update, list, or run scheduled remote agents (routines) on a cron schedule or once at a specific time. - When the user wants to schedule a recurring or one-time remote agent ("run this every Monday", "open a cleanup PR for X in 2 weeks"), or to manage existing routines. ALSO OFFER PROACTIVELY: after you finish work that has a natural future follow-up, end your reply with a one-line offer to schedule a background agent to do it. Strong signals: a feature flag / gate / experiment / staged rollout was just shipped (offer a one-time agent in ~2 weeks to open a cleanup PR or evaluate results), a new alert/monitor was created (offer a recurring agent to triage it), a TODO/migration with a "remove once X" condition was left behind (offer a one-time agent to do the removal). Skip the offer for refactors, bug fixes, and anything that is done once it ships. Name a concrete action and cadence ("in 2 weeks", "every Monday") and only offer when the run just succeeded — do not pitch a schedule for something that has not happened yet.
- claude-api: Build, debug, and optimize Claude API / Anthropic SDK apps. Apps built with this skill should include prompt caching. Also handles migrating existing Claude API code between Claude model versions (4.5 → 4.6, 4.6 → 4.7, retired-model replacements).
TRIGGER when: code imports `anthropic`/`@anthropic-ai/sdk`; user asks for the Claude API, Anthropic SDK, or Managed Agents; user adds/modifies/tunes a Claude feature (caching, thinking, compaction, tool use, batch, files, citations, memory) or model (Opus/Sonnet/Haiku) in a file; questions about prompt caching / cache hit rate in an Anthropic SDK project.
SKIP: file imports `openai`/other-provider SDK, filename like `*-openai.py`/`*-generic.py`, provider-neutral code, general programming/ML.

content.text:
Excellent! Now I have all the files. Let me compile a comprehensive report of the entire codebase structure, functions, and cross-file dependencies:

## Complete Codebase Analysis Report

### File Tree Structure

```
/Users/praveensam/Documents/work/autom9/autom9-extension/
├── src/
│   ├── main.ts                    (Entry point - mounts App component)
│   ├── app.css                    (Global styles)
│   ├── App.svelte                 (Main app component - initialization and shell layout)
│   ├── lib/
│   │   ├── api.ts                 (HTTP client for backend communication)
│   │   └── tableau.ts             (Tableau extension wrapper)
│   ├── stores/
│   │   ├── session.svelte.ts      (Session state - sessionId, tableauUserId, tokenMap)
│   │   ├── status.svelte.ts       (Integration health status state)
│   │   ├── chat.svelte.ts         (Chat history and state management)
│   │   └── data.svelte.ts         (Data panel state - worksheets, tasks, available days)
│   └── components/
│       ├── StatusBar.svelte       (Integration status display)
│       ├── AdminConfig.svelte     (Admin credential and config management)
│       ├── DataPanel.svelte       (Tableau worksheet and task list display)
│       ├── OpenWorkPanel.svelte   (Open work opportunities display)
│       ├── ChatPanel.svelte       (Chat interface - message handling and actions)
│       ├── MessageList.svelte     (Chat message rendering)
│       ├── InputBar.svelte        (User input textarea with send button)
│       ├── ActionConfirm.svelte   (Tool action confirmation dialog)
│       └── WorkflowConfigPanel.svelte (Workflow configuration upload)
├── vite.config.ts                 (Vite build configuration)
├── svelte.config.js               (Svelte compiler configuration)
├── package.json                   (Project metadata and dependencies)
└── tsconfig files
```

---

### Detailed Source Files Analysis

#### **1. `/src/main.ts` (Entry Point)**
**Functions/Exports:**
- Mounts the App component to the DOM element with id "app"

**Cross-file Dependencies:**
- Imports: `App` from `./App.svelte`

---

#### **2. `/src/lib/api.ts` (HTTP Client)**
**Classes:**
- `ApiError` (extends Error) - Custom error class with `code`, `message`, and `status` properties

**Functions:**
- `apiFetch<T>(path: string, init?: RequestInit): Promise<T>` - Generic HTTP fetch wrapper with timeout and error handling
  - Wraps all HTTP calls with 10-second timeout
  - Converts non-2xx responses and network errors to `ApiError`
  - Returns parsed JSON or throws `ApiError`

**Configuration:**
- `BACKEND_URL` - From env var `VITE_BACKEND_URL` or defaults to `http://localhost:8000`
- `FETCH_TIMEOUT_MS` - Set to 10 seconds

**Cross-file Dependencies:**
- Used by: `App.svelte`, `ChatPanel.svelte`, `AdminConfig.svelte`, `DataPanel.svelte`, `OpenWorkPanel.svelte`, `WorkflowConfigPanel.svelte`

---

#### **3. `/src/lib/tableau.ts` (Tableau Extension Wrapper)**
**Types:**
- `TableauExtensions` - Type for Tableau window global
- `WorksheetRow` - Generic row object keyed by field names

**Functions:**
- `initializeExtension(): Promise<void>` - Initializes Tableau runtime; resolves immediately in dev environment
- `getTableauUserId(): string` - Returns Tableau user ID or "dev-user"/"unknown-user" fallbacks
- `getWorksheetData(worksheetName: string): Promise<WorksheetRow[]>` - Reads summary data from named Tableau worksheet; returns empty array in dev environment

**Global State:**
- `initialized` - Boolean flag to prevent multiple initializations

**Cross-file Dependencies:**
- Used by: `App.svelte` (initialization), `DataPanel.svelte` (worksheet data loading)

---

#### **4. `/src/stores/session.svelte.ts` (Session State Store)**
**Interfaces:**
- (None exported; uses interface types only)

**Classes:**
- `SessionStore` - Svelte 5 reactive store with:
  - `sessionId: string | null` - Backend session identifier
  - `tableauUserId: string | null` - Tableau user identifier
  - `tokenMap: Map<string, string>` - Token-to-value mapping for masking pipeline

**Exports:**
- `sessionStore` - Singleton instance

**Cross-file Dependencies:**
- Used by: `App.svelte` (set session ID), `ChatPanel.svelte` (build session headers), `DataPanel.svelte` (session headers), `OpenWorkPanel.svelte` (session headers)

---

#### **5. `/src/stores/status.svelte.ts` (Integration Status Store)**
**Interfaces:**
- `IntegrationStatus` - Objects with `name`, `status` ('healthy'|'unavailable'), `latency_ms`, `error`

**Classes:**
- `StatusStore` - Svelte 5 reactive store with:
  - `integrations: IntegrationStatus[]` - Array of integration status objects
  - `loading: boolean` - Fetch state
  - `error: string | null` - Error message

**Exports:**
- `statusStore` - Singleton instance

**Cross-file Dependencies:**
- Used by: `App.svelte` (populate on mount), `StatusBar.svelte` (display)

---

#### **6. `/src/stores/chat.svelte.ts` (Chat State Store)**
**Interfaces:**
- `ChatMessage` - `{ role: 'user' | 'assistant'; content: string }`
- `ToolCallProposal` - `{ tool_name: string; action: string; params: Record<string, unknown>; display_text: string }`

**Classes:**
- `ChatStore` - Svelte 5 reactive store with:
  - `messages: ChatMessage[]` - Message history
  - `chatState: ChatState` - 'idle' | 'loading' | 'error'
  - `chatError: string | null` - Error message
  - `pendingAction: ToolCallProposal | null` - Pending tool action awaiting confirmation
  - Methods:
    - `history: ChatMessage[]` (getter) - Returns messages
    - `addUserMessage(content: string): void`
    - `addAssistantMessage(content: string): void`
    - `setError(msg: string): void`
    - `clearError(): void`
    - `setPendingAction(action: ToolCallProposal): void`
    - `clearPendingAction(): void`

**Exports:**
- `chatStore` - Singleton instance

**Cross-file Dependencies:**
- Used by: `ChatPanel.svelte` (message management, state), `ActionConfirm.svelte` (action type), `MessageList.svelte` (type), `InputBar.svelte` (indirectly via ChatPanel)

---

#### **7. `/src/stores/data.svelte.ts` (Data Panel State Store)**
**Interfaces:**
- `TaskItem` - `{ text: string }`

**Functions:**
- `extractAvailableDays(rows: WorksheetRow[], columnName?: string | null): number | null` - Extracts available days from first row; searches for "open" column by default or specified column name

**Classes:**
- `DataStore` - Svelte 5 reactive store with:
  - `worksheetRows: WorksheetRow[]` - Tableau worksheet data
  - `worksheetState: DataLoadState` - 'idle'|'loading'|'done'|'error'
  - `worksheetError: string | null`
  - `availableDays: number | null` - Extracted from worksheetRows
  - `tasks: TaskItem[]` - Task list from Google Docs
  - `tasksState: DataLoadState`
  - `tasksError: string | null`

**Exports:**
- `dataStore` - Singleton instance
- `extractAvailableDays` function

**Cross-file Dependencies:**
- Used by: `DataPanel.svelte` (load and display), `ChatPanel.svelte` (build session context)

---

#### **8. `/src/App.svelte` (Main Application Shell)**
**Component Props:** None

**Reactive State:**
- `isAdminView: boolean` - From URL parameter
- `appStatus: AppStatus` - 'loading'|'ready'|'error'
- `errorMessage: string`

**Logic:**
- `onMount` hook that:
  1. Initializes Tableau extension via `initializeExtension()`
  2. Gets Tableau user ID and stores it in `sessionStore.tableauUserId`
  3. Creates backend session via POST `/api/sessions` and stores ID
  4. Fetches integration statuses via GET `/api/status` and populates `statusStore`

**Child Components:**
- `StatusBar`, `AdminConfig` (conditional), `DataPanel`, `OpenWorkPanel`, `ChatPanel`

**Cross-file Dependencies:**
- Imports: `initializeExtension`, `getTableauUserId` from `lib/tableau`
- Imports: `apiFetch`, `ApiError` from `lib/api`
- Imports: `sessionStore` from `stores/session.svelte`
- Imports: `statusStore` from `stores/status.svelte`
- Calls: All initialization and API setup

---

#### **9. `/src/components/StatusBar.svelte` (Integration Status Display)**
**Props:** None

**State/Logic:**
- Maps integration names to display names
- Displays loading, error, or list of integration statuses

**Cross-file Dependencies:**
- Imports: `statusStore` from `stores/status.svelte`

---

#### **10. `/src/components/ChatPanel.svelte` (Chat Interface)**
**Component Props:** None

**Functions:**
- `sessionHeaders(): Record<string, string>` - Returns session header for API calls
- `buildSessionContext(): Record<string, string>` - Extracts first row of worksheet data for masking pipeline context
- `sendMessage(message: string): Promise<void>` - Sends user message to `/api/chat` endpoint
  - Handles pending actions from response
  - Updates chat store with user and assistant messages
- `confirmAction(): Promise<void>` - Confirms pending tool action via `/api/chat`
- `cancelAction(): void` - Cancels pending action locally

**Child Components:**
- `MessageList`, `InputBar`, `ActionConfirm`

**Cross-file Dependencies:**
- Imports: `apiFetch`, `ApiError` from `lib/api`
- Imports: `sessionStore` from `stores/session.svelte`
- Imports: `chatStore`, `ToolCallProposal` from `stores/chat.svelte`
- Imports: `dataStore` from `stores/data.svelte`
- Calls: All API endpoints for chat interactions

---

#### **11. `/src/components/MessageList.svelte` (Chat Message Display)**
**Component Props:**
- `messages: ChatMessage[]`

**Logic:**
- Renders messages with user (right-aligned blue) vs assistant (left-aligned gray) styling
- Auto-scrolls to bottom on new messages using `$effect`

**Cross-file Dependencies:**
- Imports: `ChatMessage` type from `stores/chat.svelte`

---

#### **12. `/src/components/InputBar.svelte` (User Input Component)**
**Component Props:**
- `onSend: (message: string) => void` - Callback for sending
- `disabled?: boolean` - Disable state

**Functions:**
- `handleSend(): void` - Validates input and calls `onSend`
- `handleKeydown(event: KeyboardEvent): void` - Sends on Enter (without Shift)

**Cross-file Dependencies:** None

---

#### **13. `/src/components/ActionConfirm.svelte` (Action Confirmation Dialog)**
**Component Props:**
- `action: ToolCallProposal`
- `onConfirm: () => void`
- `onCancel: () => void`

**Logic:**
- Displays action proposal and confirmation/cancel buttons

**Cross-file Dependencies:**
- Imports: `ToolCallProposal` type from `stores/chat.svelte`

---

#### **14. `/src/components/DataPanel.svelte` (Worksheet and Task Display)**
**Functions:**
- `loadWorksheetConfig(): Promise<WorksheetConfig>` - Fetches config from `/api/config/workflow`
- `loadWorksheetData(worksheetName: string, availableDaysColumn: string | null): Promise<void>` - Loads worksheet data and extracts available days
- `loadTasks(): Promise<void>` - Fetches task list from `/api/data/tasks`

**Logic:**
- `onMount` hook that:
  1. Loads worksheet configuration
  2. Loads worksheet data and tasks in parallel (via `Promise.allSettled`)
  3. Uses abort guard to prevent stale writes on remount

**Cross-file Dependencies:**
- Imports: `apiFetch`, `ApiError` from `lib/api`
- Imports: `getWorksheetData` from `lib/tableau`
- Imports: `sessionStore` from `stores/session.svelte`
- Imports: `dataStore`, `extractAvailableDays` from `stores/data.svelte`

---

#### **15. `/src/components/OpenWorkPanel.svelte` (Open Work Display)**
**Functions:**
- `badgeLabel(type: string): string` - Maps type to display label
- `fieldEntries(opp: OpportunityItem): [string, string][]` - Filters and returns opportunity fields
- `loadOpenWork(): Promise<void>` - Fetches opportunities from `/api/data/open-work`

**State:**
- `state: LoadState` - 'idle'|'loading'|'done'|'error'
- `opportunities: OpportunityItem[]`
- `errorMessage: string | null`

**Logic:**
- `onMount` hook calls `loadOpenWork()`

**Cross-file Dependencies:**
- Imports: `apiFetch` from `lib/api`
- Imports: `sessionStore` from `stores/session.svelte`

---

#### **16. `/src/components/AdminConfig.svelte` (Credential Management)**
**Functions:**
- `handleSubmit(e: SubmitEvent): Promise<void>` - Saves credentials to `/api/admin/credentials`

**State:**
- `provider: 'openai'|'anthropic'`
- `apiKey: string`
- `saving: boolean`
- `saved: boolean`
- `errorMsg: string`
- `existingMasked: string | null`

**Logic:**
- `onMount` fetches existing masked key from `/api/admin/credentials/{provider}`
- Form submission sends provider and API key to backend

**Child Components:**
- `WorkflowConfigPanel`

**Cross-file Dependencies:**
- Imports: `apiFetch` from `lib/api`

---

#### **17. `/src/components/WorkflowConfigPanel.svelte` (Workflow Configuration Upload)**
**Functions:**
- `handleSubmit(e: SubmitEvent): Promise<void>` - Parses JSON and uploads to `/api/admin/config`

**State:**
- `configJson: string`
- `saving: boolean`
- `saved: boolean`
- `errorMsg: string`

**Logic:**
- Form with textarea for JSON workflow configuration
- Validates JSON before submission
- Posts to `/api/admin/config` endpoint

**Cross-file Dependencies:**
- Imports: `apiFetch` from `lib/api`

---

### Cross-File Dependency Graph

```
ENTRY POINT: main.ts
    ↓
    App.svelte (INITIALIZATION HUB)
    ├── Calls: initializeExtension() [lib/tableau]
    ├── Calls: getTableauUserId() [lib/tableau]
    ├── Calls: apiFetch POST /api/sessions [lib/api]
    ├── Calls: apiFetch GET /api/status [lib/api]
    ├── Writes: sessionStore.sessionId [stores/session.svelte]
    ├── Writes: sessionStore.tableauUserId [stores/session.svelte]
    ├── Writes: statusStore.integrations [stores/status.svelte]
    │
    ├── Component: StatusBar.svelte
    │   └── Reads: statusStore [stores/status.svelte]
    │
    ├── Component: AdminConfig.svelte
    │   ├── Calls: apiFetch GET /api/admin/credentials/{provider} [lib/api]
    │   ├── Calls: apiFetch POST /api/admin/credentials [lib/api]
    │   │
    │   └── Component: WorkflowConfigPanel.svelte
    │       ├── Calls: apiFetch POST /api/admin/config [lib/api]
    │
    ├── Component: DataPanel.svelte
    │   ├── Calls: apiFetch GET /api/config/workflow [lib/api]
    │   ├── Calls: getWorksheetData() [lib/tableau]
    │   ├── Calls: extractAvailableDays() [stores/data.svelte]
    │   ├── Calls: apiFetch GET /api/data/tasks [lib/api]
    │   ├── Reads: sessionStore.sessionId [stores/session.svelte]
    │   ├── Writes: dataStore.* [stores/data.svelte]
    │   │
    │   └── Displays: dataStore.worksheetRows [stores/data.svelte]
    │
    ├── Component: OpenWorkPanel.svelte
    │   ├── Calls: apiFetch GET /api/data/open-work [lib/api]
    │   ├── Reads: sessionStore.sessionId [stores/session.svelte]
    │
    └── Component: ChatPanel.svelte
        ├── Calls: apiFetch POST /api/chat (message) [lib/api]
        ├── Calls: apiFetch POST /api/chat (confirm_action) [lib/api]
        ├── Reads: sessionStore.sessionId [stores/session.svelte]
        ├── Reads: chatStore.* [stores/chat.svelte]
        ├── Reads: dataStore.worksheetRows [stores/data.svelte]
        ├── Calls: buildSessionContext() [internal to ChatPanel]
        ├── Writes: chatStore.* [stores/chat.svelte]
        │
        ├── Component: MessageList.svelte
        │   └── Displays: chatStore.messages [stores/chat.svelte]
        │
        ├── Component: InputBar.svelte
        │   └── Emits: onSend callback
        │
        └── Component: ActionConfirm.svelte
            └── Displays: chatStore.pendingAction [stores/chat.svelte]
```

---

### Key Observations

**Entry Points:**
1. `main.ts` - Mounts the app
2. `App.svelte` - Initialization hub that sets up session, status, and layout

**API Endpoints Called:**
- POST `/api/sessions` - Session creation
- GET `/api/status` - Integration status check
- GET `/api/config/workflow` - Workflow configuration
- GET `/api/data/tasks` - Task list
- GET `/api/data/open-work` - Open work opportunities
- POST `/api/chat` - Chat message and action confirmation
- GET `/api/admin/credentials/{provider}` - Fetch masked credentials
- POST `/api/admin/credentials` - Save credentials
- POST `/api/admin/config` - Upload workflow config

**State Management Pattern:**
- Svelte 5 reactive stores with `$state` and `$effect`
- Four singleton stores: `sessionStore`, `statusStore`, `chatStore`, `dataStore`
- Reactive updates trigger component re-renders automatically
